title: The 10 Best Cordless String Trimmers
subtitle: Battery-powered string trimmers and trimmer-edgers for lawns and weeds, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A cordless string trimmer handles edges, fences and weeds without gas or a pull cord. We ranked 10 best-sellers from WORX, BLACK+DECKER, EGO, Greenworks and CRAFTSMAN on rating, review volume and features (a 13-inch or wider swath, auto or push-button line feed, an edger mode and a battery in the box).

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: WORX 20V 12" 2-in-1 Cordless String Trimmer and Edger (WG163)
products.verdict: The best seller and most-reviewed trimmer here, with 28,563 reviews: a light 20V trimmer that converts to an edger, with a push-button line feed and a head that tilts for slopes.
products.best_for: Small and medium yards that need trimming and edging.
products.skip_if: You have thick weeds; a 15-16 in EGO cuts faster.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 20V MAX 12" String Trimmer and Edger with Auto Feed (LST300)
products.verdict: A cheap, popular trimmer-edger with BLACK+DECKER's automatic feed spool, so you never bump for line, and a 2-year warranty.
products.skip_if: You want a wide swath or long runtime.

products.name: WORX 20V 12" 3-in-1 Cordless String Trimmer, Edger and Mini Mower (WG170)

specs.extras: Converts to edger and wheeled mini mower; 7 handle and 6 head positions

products.verdict: WORX's 3-in-1 that also works as a small wheeled mower for patches too small to drag a mower to, with lots of handle and head adjustments.
products.best_for: Tiny yards and strips where a mower is overkill.
products.skip_if: You have a real lawn to mow; it's a mini mower.

products.name: WORX 20V 10" 2-in-1 Cordless String Trimmer and Edger (WG154)
products.verdict: WORX's smallest trimmer at 4.2 lb, with auto feed and edging, for townhouse yards and borders.
products.best_for: Small yards and anyone who wants the lightest trimmer.
products.skip_if: You trim a lot; the 10 in swath is narrow.

products.name: Greenworks 40V 12" Cordless String Trimmer, 2.0Ah Battery and Charger
products.verdict: A 40V trimmer with dual .065 in line, auto feed and a variable speed trigger, on Greenworks' 40V platform.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 13" String Trimmer and Edger Kit with 4Ah Battery (CMCST901)

specs.extras: Up to 63 min runtime, adjustable height

products.verdict: A CRAFTSMAN kit with a big 4.0Ah battery for up to 63 minutes, a 13-inch swath and an edger mode, rated 4.6 stars.
products.best_for: CRAFTSMAN V20 owners and anyone wanting long runtime for the money.
products.skip_if: You want a long track record; it has 194 reviews.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER 40V MAX 13" String Trimmer/Edger with Telescoping Pole (LST136)

specs.extras: PowerCommand dial (power or runtime), telescoping pole

products.verdict: A 40V trimmer with a dial that trades power for runtime, auto feed and a telescoping pole that suits taller users.
products.skip_if: You want brushless; it isn't listed.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 15" Cordless String Trimmer with Battery and Charger (ST1502SA)
products.verdict: EGO's 15-inch trimmer uses thick .095 in pro line and a Rapid Reload head for weeds that stall smaller trimmers.
products.best_for: Bigger yards with thick weeds and long grass.
products.skip_if: You need edging; there's no edger mode listed.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 15" Cordless String Trimmer with POWERLOAD (ST1511T)
products.verdict: Adds EGO's POWERLOAD head, which winds new line at the push of a button, plus a telescopic shaft.

products.name: EGO POWER+ 16" Cordless String Trimmer with LINE IQ and Carbon Fiber Shaft (ST1623T)
products.verdict: EGO's top trimmer: a 16-inch swath, LINE IQ that feeds line automatically as it senses wear, POWERLOAD winding and a carbon fiber shaft.
products.best_for: Large properties that want gas-trimmer performance without gas.

avoid.name: Cordless Weed Wacker Compatible with DEWALT 20V Max Battery, Tool Only
avoid.verdict: A DEWALT-battery knockoff sold as a 'professional-grade' 3-in-1 that runs thinner line than anything we rank and feeds line every time you start it.
reasons: It uses 0.055 in trimmer line, thinner than the .065 to .095 in line on the trimmers we rank; thin line snaps quickly on weeds.
Its auto-feed 'releases 0.4" of line every time you start the tool', which burns through line on short jobs.
DEWALT owners can buy a DEWALT-made trimmer; for budget buyers, the WORX WG154 and BLACK+DECKER kits include a battery and have thousands of reviews.

buyers_guide.q: How wide a swath do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 10 to 12 inches suits small yards and edges. 13 to 16 inches finishes bigger properties faster and handles thicker growth.
Thicker line (.080 to .095 in) cuts weeds and tough grass without snapping. Thin line (.065 in and below) is fine for grass edges and small yards.
Auto feed advances line without tapping the head on the ground. EGO's POWERLOAD winds new line at the push of a button. Both save time over refilling spools by hand.

buyers_guide.q: Do I need an edger mode?
buyers_guide.a: If you want clean lines along sidewalks and driveways, yes. 2-in-1 trimmers rotate the head and add a wheel for edging.
20V is light and fine for small yards. 40V and EGO's 56V run longer and cut thicker growth. Pick the platform you'll use for other yard tools.
